executive_summary:
# EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

B — PARTIAL / TARGET REPAIR VERIFIED; BROWSER VERIFICATION BLOCKED

The original harmless mud-prints candidate was recovered and replayed: REVIEW_REQUIRED / optional_disclosure_overlap. A finite full-sentence attention matcher now uses the current engine-projected public target. Other claims remain subject to semantic, legacy, overlap and bounded-presentation checks. The current-action trusted disclosure and shared structured/chat publication boundary remain intact. Repeat fallback now states the action and the no-new-information outcome once each.

114 development checks pass (including 53 PR68 controls and six PR62 checks). Fresh developer-authored frozen holdout: 60/60 once. Focused regression: 893 passed / 3 failed; boundary: 82 passed / 0 failed; broader: 0 passed / 9 failed. New focused failures: [].

Five real localhost HTTP actions, four gpt-4.1-mini requests, 2060 tokens: one accepted/published target reference and three correct disclosure-duplication fallbacks. Browser attachment failed twice; zero browser gameplay actions and zero browser-originated AI publications. No screenshots exist for this cycle. Zero observed mandatory omissions, critical unsafe publications or hidden sentinel exposures. Raw matched authoritative controls equal enabled runs 5/5; experimental flags remain default off and request/session bound. Protected entry hashes unchanged. No commit/push.

This is a bounded reproduced repair and related developer-authored validation, not independent external validation, an official ATGB result or proof of broad naturalness. Proceed to PR-PLAY-70: Meaningful Player Choice & Branching Consequences; browser validation remains required there. No further presentation-only cycle is recommended.
